headline: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir elected Bangladesh's 23rd president
summary: Winning by a margin of 167 votes, the veteran BNP leader moves from the streets to Bangabhaban after a historic ballot.
details: Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has been elected as the 23rd President of Bangladesh. He secured 255 votes to defeat his opponent, Oli Ahmed, by a margin of 167 votes.

The Election Commission has issued a formal gazette declaring him the winner. Congratulations have poured in from Prime Minister Muhammad Yunus, various political leaders, and international representatives from the UK and China.
Fakhrul's journey to the presidency is being described as a historic transition from a student activist and street leader to the highest office in the land.
Following his election, the BNP has appointed veteran leader Ruhul Kabir Rizvi as acting Secretary General with immediate effect to fill the vacancy left by Fakhrul.
The new president expressed his vision for the country, stating his dream of a happy, prosperous, and welfare-oriented Bangladesh.
The transition marks a significant political shift, with the interim president Hafiz Uddin Ahmed officially departing from Bangabhaban.
caption:
From the streets to Bangabhaban. Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir is now the 23rd President of Bangladesh.

Mirza Fakhrul Islam Alamgir has been elected as the 23rd President of Bangladesh. He secured 255 votes to defeat his opponent, Oli Ahmed, by a margin of 167 votes.

The Election Commission has issued a formal gazette declaring him the winner. Congratulations have poured in from Prime Minister Muhammad Yunus, various political leaders, and international representatives from the UK and China.

Fakhrul's journey to the presidency is being described as a historic transition from a student activist and street leader to the highest office in the land.

Following his election, the BNP has appointed veteran leader Ruhul Kabir Rizvi as acting Secretary General with immediate effect to fill the vacancy left by Fakhrul.

The new president expressed his vision for the country, stating his dream of a happy, prosperous, and welfare-oriented Bangladesh.

The transition marks a significant political shift, with the interim president Hafiz Uddin Ahmed officially departing from Bangabhaban.

headline: Cabinet to decide rollout of new pay scale for govt employees
summary: Prime Minister's Finance Advisor Dr. Rashed Al Mahmud Titumir says final preparations are underway for the implementation of the new salary structure.
details: Prime Minister's Finance Advisor Dr. Rashed Al Mahmud Titumir announced that the final stages of work are underway to implement the new pay scale for government employees.
He told reporters at the Secretariat on Thursday that the official announcement will be made once the final verification and scrutiny process is completed.
Addressing the energy crisis, Dr. Titumir stated that the government is making every effort to resolve the issue and will ensure a three-month fuel reserve.
He added that load-shedding is expected to decrease during the upcoming winter and a sustainable energy state will be achieved by 2029.
The government's target is to ensure at least 5,000 megawatts of electricity from renewable sources by 2029 to provide relief to the people.

Regarding inflation, the Finance Advisor mentioned that the government is implementing various initiatives to control it, criticizing the previous administration for taking unrestrained loans that were not used sustainably.
caption:
New pay scale for government employees is nearing its final stage. The Cabinet will decide the rollout.

Prime Minister's Finance Advisor Dr. Rashed Al Mahmud Titumir announced that the final stages of work are underway to implement the new pay scale for government employees.

He told reporters at the Secretariat on Thursday that the official announcement will be made once the final verification and scrutiny process is completed.

Addressing the energy crisis, Dr. Titumir stated that the government is making every effort to resolve the issue and will ensure a three-month fuel reserve.

He added that load-shedding is expected to decrease during the upcoming winter and a sustainable energy state will be achieved by 2029.

The government's target is to ensure at least 5,000 megawatts of electricity from renewable sources by 2029 to provide relief to the people.

Regarding inflation, the Finance Advisor mentioned that the government is implementing various initiatives to control it, criticizing the previous administration for taking unrestrained loans that were not used sustainably.
